incidents.title: AsyncRAT campaign with GenAI-written VBScript and JavaScript
incidents.outcome: Infection chain deployed AsyncRAT remote access trojan.
incidents.confidenceReason: HP Wolf judged GenAI authorship highly likely from unobfuscated code, comments and naming; no model named.
incidents.summary: HP Wolf found a campaign spreading AsyncRAT through HTML smuggling and VBScript/JavaScript droppers. The scripts' structure, comments and variable names pointed to generative AI authorship.
incidents.quote: a malware campaign spreading AsyncRAT using VBScript (T1059.005) and JavaScript (T1059.007) that was highly likely to have been written with the help of GenAI.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only HP Wolf Security has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

harness.note: AI used as a chatbot/assistant, no agent harness
